items.title: Bill Huntington Interview, 1961-12-27
items.q: We were supposed to get up a trio... I was supposed to play classic guitar. Bob was going to play vibes and Bill Russell was going to play violin.

ctx.x: But I couldn't figure out what he was intense about, you know. Pretty confused, I guess. I think he wanted to play the original. Like I'll do. Yeah. I think that was his, uh, I think that was his big thing. Playing the original. Anyway, he, uh, Bob laid it, went down completely on the orange jazz. Put it down, like, as being a crude form of music, I think. With the exception of very few musicians. And, uh, he was, uh, he was, uh, he was, uh, he was, uh, he was, uh, he was, uh, he was, Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.…
